summary: No for buying dips. Whether %B crossed down through 0.1, stayed below 0, or crossed down through 0 with Length 7, price did no better than after random candles on 1h, 4h or daily. The result that holds up is about the upper band: after %B went above 1, price kept rising, and shorts did 0.36% worse than random on 1h and 1.16% worse on 4h after 20 candles.

verdicts.use: Buying below the lower band (crosses down 0.1, below 0)
verdicts.text: No better than random entries on 1h, 4h or daily. This holds for the cross down through 0.1, for %B staying below 0, and for the Length 7 cross down through 0.
Worse than random on 1h, 4h and daily, because price kept rising after %B went above 1. On 1h and 4h it holds without its strongest stretch, and uptrends carry it.

Price moved more than after random candles on 4h and daily, in a window that rose. These crosses fire in volatile candles, so the result comes from when they fire, not from picking direction. On 1h it showed nothing.

notes: On 1h, KC %B crossing down through 0.1 gave 4,625 entries in 1,975 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.06% ahead of random entries, inside the luck band. Staying below 0 enters nearly twice as often and ends 0.05% behind, also inside the band. The Length 7 cross down through 0 fires about a fifth as often as the 0.1 cross and shows nothing either, in uptrends or downtrends.

Shorting while %B was above 1 did 0.36% worse than random entries after 20 candles on 1h, 1.16% worse on 4h and 8.31% worse after 20 days on daily. On 1h it shows at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles and holds without its strongest stretch. On 4h it holds without its strongest stretch and shows at 10, 20 and 100 candles, but not at 50. A close above the upper band marked strength that continued, not a top.

Uptrends carry that short result. In uptrends it did 0.36% worse than random on 1h and 1.09% worse on 4h. In downtrends it showed nothing on 4h. On 1h the downtrend result rests on signals on May 8–9, 2025, and without them it is chance.

%B crossing up through 1 fires mostly in volatile candles. On 4h, price was 0.77% ahead of random entries after 20 candles, and 8.47% ahead after 20 days on daily, in a window where price rose overall. That is price moving more after those candles, not a pick of direction. On 4h it came from uptrends (0.93% ahead), and downtrends showed nothing. On daily the uptrend result vanishes without signals between Jul 31, 2021 and Aug 27, 2021.

Single stretches can fake a dip result. On 4h in downtrends, the Length 7 cross down through 0 looked 2.01% worse than random, but only because of signals on Nov 7–9, 2022, during the FTX collapse. On 4h in downtrends, %B below 0 looked 0.82% worse only because of signals between Jun 10, 2022 and Jun 18, 2022. One result does hold: on SOL 4h, the cross down through 0.1 did 1.42% worse than random, and it holds without its strongest stretch and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles.

For a long DCA bot, %B under the lower band adds no timing on these pairs, so the DCA orders and take profit do the work. If a short bot opens while %B is above 1, it trades against moves that kept going, mostly in uptrends. Leave that condition out of a short bot, or use it as a filter that blocks shorts. The 4h cross up through 1 can sit beside your other long conditions, but in downtrends it showed nothing.
